在商店出售物品换卢比
Selling items at a shop for Rupees
卖东西前先对一下价：宝石和料理的卖法不一样（游戏实机截图）

王国之泪里花钱的地方很多：防具强化、箭矢、马匹登录、拆解都要卢比。刷钱没有一招通吃，前期靠打猎烤肉，中期靠挖矿卖宝石，后期靠钻石回收和高级料理。下面按阶段讲，每种方法都给出具体数字，照着做就不会亏。

There are many places to spend money in Tears of the Kingdom: armor upgrades, arrows, horse registration, and dismantling all cost Rupees. No single money-making trick works for everything: hunt and roast meat early on, mine and sell gems in the mid-game, and rely on diamond buyback and high-end dishes late in the game. The sections below go stage by stage, with concrete numbers for each method, so following them means you won't lose out.
⭐ 本篇要点
⭐ Key Points of This Guide
宝石售价：钻石500、蓝宝石150、红宝石110、黄玉80、蛋白石30、夜光石20、琥珀10。
Gem selling prices: Diamond 500, Sapphire 150, Ruby 110, Topaz 80, Opal 30, Luminous Stone 20, Amber 10.
鼓隆城的拉梅拉收钻石：10颗给5500卢比，合550一颗，比直接卖多50。
Ramella in Goron City buys diamonds: 5,500 Rupees for 10, or 550 each — 50 more per stone than selling directly.
料理售价看食材总价乘倍率：1到5个食材分别乘1.2、1.3、1.4、1.6、1.8。
A dish's selling price is the total value of its ingredients times a multiplier: 1.2 for 1 ingredient, 1.3 for 2, 1.4 for 3, 1.6 for 4, and 1.8 for 5.
顶级兽肉×5的烤肉串卖315卢比，高级兽肉×5卖135卢比，是前期最稳的刷钱法。
A skewer made from 5 Raw Gourmet Meats sells for 315 Rupees, and one from 5 Raw Prime Meats sells for 135 Rupees — the most reliable early-game money-making method.
雪原驿站周边打猎是前期经典点：熊和驼鹿出肉多，肉冻住前要快捡。
Hunting around Snowfield Stable is a classic early-game spot: bears and moose drop a lot of meat, and you need to pick it up quickly before it freezes.

鼓隆城的拉梅拉会按 10 颗钻石 5500 卢比回收，折合每颗 550，比商店直接卖的 500 多 50。攒够 10 颗再去找她，一次多赚 500。注意钻石也是部分防具的强化材料，强化清单里的钻石要先留够，剩下的再拿去换钱。

Ramella in Goron City buys back diamonds at 5,500 Rupees for 10, or 550 each — 50 more per stone than the 500 you get selling directly to a shop. Save up 10 before going to see her, and you earn an extra 500 in one trip. Note that diamonds are also upgrade materials for some armor, so first set aside the diamonds on your upgrade list, and only trade in the rest for cash.
出售素材换取卢比
Selling materials for Rupees
攒够数量再卖：批量回收往往更划算（游戏实机截图）
Save up a batch before selling: bulk buyback is often more profitable (in-game screenshot)
料理的售价不是食材售价简单相加，而是食材售价合计乘一个倍率：1 个食材乘 1.2，2 个乘 1.3，3 个乘 1.4，4 个乘 1.6，5 个乘 1.8。所以做料理卖钱一定要做满 5 个食材，倍率最高。两个最实用的例子：顶级兽肉×5 的烤肉串卖 315 卢比，高级兽肉×5 卖 135 卢比，肉的来源就是下一节的打猎。

A dish's selling price is not simply the sum of its ingredients' selling prices; it is the ingredients' total selling price times a multiplier: 1.2 for 1 ingredient, 1.3 for 2, 1.4 for 3, 1.6 for 4, and 1.8 for 5. So when cooking dishes to sell, always use a full 5 ingredients for the highest multiplier. Two of the most practical examples: a skewer of 5 Raw Gourmet Meats sells for 315 Rupees, and a skewer of 5 Raw Prime Meats sells for 135 Rupees, and the meat comes from the hunting described in the next section.
别拿带效果的食材做卖钱料理：效果食材本身贵，做成料理反而可能亏。卖钱料理只用纯回血的肉，效果料理留着自己吃，分开算账最清楚。

Don't use effect ingredients for dishes you plan to sell: effect ingredients are expensive on their own, and cooking them into a dish can actually lose you money. For dishes to sell, use only plain health-restoring meat, and keep effect dishes for your own use — keeping the two accounts separate is clearest.
前期没矿可挖、没宝石可卖的时候，雪原驿站周边是最经典的刷钱点：那里的熊和驼鹿出肉多，一趟能打不少顶级和高级兽肉。打猎要点是快：肉掉在雪地里会冻住，冻住前赶紧捡，捡回来找锅做成 5 肉烤肉串再卖，一趟就是几百卢比。

When you have no ore to mine and no gems to sell early on, the area around Snowfield Stable is the classic money-making spot: the bears and moose there drop a lot of meat, and one trip can yield plenty of Raw Gourmet Meat and Raw Prime Meat. The key to hunting is speed: meat dropped on the snow will freeze, so grab it quickly before it does, then find a pot, cook it into 5-meat skewers, and sell them — one trip is worth several hundred Rupees.
三条取舍原则：第一，强化材料不卖，宁可少赚也别回头再刷；第二，钻石攒 10 颗给拉梅拉；第三，肉优先做满 5 个的烤肉串再卖，别直接卖生肉。按这个顺序，卢比会越攒越顺，前期买箭、中期强化防具都不用再为钱发愁。

Three rules for what to sell and what to keep: first, never sell upgrade materials — better to earn less than to farm them all over again later; second, save up 10 diamonds for Ramella; third, always cook meat into full 5-meat skewers before selling, never sell raw meat directly. Follow this order and your Rupees will pile up smoothly, so you won't have to worry about money when buying arrows early on or upgrading armor in the mid-game.
